title: Berry Skyr Cheesecake Cups
description: A light cheesecake-style cup with skyr, soft cheese, berries and a crisp oat base.
ingredients: Lemon zest and vanilla to taste
steps: Mix the skyr, soft cheese, protein powder, lemon zest and vanilla.
Spoon toasted oats into a glass and top with the cheesecake mixture.
Add berries and chill until ready to serve.
notes: Skyr has nearly double the protein of regular yogurt for the same calories — an easy swap in any dessert-style snack.
